name: EasyTest – Simplify A/B Testing
author: WP Grids

sections.description:
EasyTest allows you to perform A/B testing, split testing, and compare pages with ease.
Enhance your website’s performance by testing different variations of your pages and elements to determine what works best.

Key Features:
– A/B testing for WordPress pages
– Split test different elements
– Compare performance between variations
– Easy-to-use interface

Optimize your website’s conversion rate effortlessly! 🚀
sections.installation:
1. Upload the EasyTest folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Start creating A/B tests from the EasyTest settings panel.
sections.faq:
Does EasyTest work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, EasyTest is designed to work with any modern WordPress theme.

Can I compare entire pages or just elements?

You can do both! EasyTest allows you to test complete pages as well as individual elements within a page.

Is coding knowledge required to use EasyTest?

No, EasyTest is beginner-friendly and does not require any coding skills.
